name: markdown-rewrite
setup:
printf '## Overview

This project does things. See https://example.com for details.

## Usage

### Install

Run the installer. Homepage: https://example.org

## License

MIT
' > doc.md && cp doc.md .doc.orig
prompt: Rewrite doc.md with two mechanical transformations: promote every heading by one level (## becomes #, ### becomes ##), and wrap every bare URL in angle brackets (https://x becomes <https://x>). Keep all other text and the line order unchanged.
verify: ! grep -Eq '^#{3,} ' doc.md && grep -qx '# Overview' doc.md && grep -qx '# Usage' doc.md && grep -qx '## Install' doc.md && grep -q '<https://example.com>' doc.md && grep -q '<https://example.org>' doc.md && grep -q 'Run the installer.' doc.md && grep -qx 'MIT' doc.md && test "$(wc -l < doc.md)" -eq "$(wc -l < .doc.orig)"
